name: ECA: Google Sheets
description: Provides ECA integration for Google Sheets.
project_description: ECA: Google Sheets is a submodule of ECA: Google that adds seven ECA action plugins for automating Google Sheets from Drupal's Event-Condition-Action workflow builder: append, read, query, update, create, clear and delete. It reuses the parent module's eca_google.google_api authentication layer (OAuth2 API client or Service Account) and exposes spreadsheet data to ECA models as tokens using a Row/Col syntax. Server-side filtering is available through Google's QUERY function via a temporary hidden sheet. Requires eca_google (and therefore eca and google_api_client) with the Google Sheets API enabled in the linked Google Cloud project.
